name: openvault
description: Visible local plugin that routes bookmark and social favorites imports into the right Obsidian archive workflow under the openvault brand.

interface.shortDescription: 统一入口：书签、小红书、B站、X
interface.longDescription: 一个可见的本地插件，只保留 1 个总入口来统一导入、同步、全局搜索和废弃清理，并把来源内搜索/废弃提升到资源根统一管理。
defaultPrompt: Use $archive-router as the single visible openvault entry for import, sync, search, and rubbish cleanup workflows.
